name: The Clockwork Orchid Garden in a Forest of Glass Leaves
description: A garden where clockwork mechanisms bloom as exotic orchids, surrounded by a forest where leaves are made of transparent glass, catching light, occasional gears visible.
prompt: Clockwork orchid garden with intricate brass gears and springs forming flower shapes, surrounding forest of glass leaves rustling in wind, light refracting through leaves, subtle glow from orchids, steampunk fantasy, hyperrealistic, detailed.
caption: Where gears blossom into orchids ⏱️🌸 Wander through a clockwork garden of glass leaf forest.
